app_store.name: Remtron5000: Private AI Chat
app_store.subtitle: Offline AI on your iPhone
app_store.promotional_text: Chat with an AI assistant that runs entirely on your iPhone. No account, no subscription, and your chats never leave your phone.
app_store.description:
Remtron5000 is an AI chat assistant that runs on your iPhone itself. There's no account to make, no subscription, and nothing you type is sent to a server.

Ask it to explain a topic, draft an email, brainstorm ideas, summarize notes or help with code. Answers stream in as they're written, with clear formatting and code you can copy in one tap.

What you get:
- Private by design: the AI model runs on your device's graphics chip
- Free: no sign-up, no ads, no in-app purchases
- Works offline once your model is downloaded
- Choose from several open-source models, from tiny and fast to larger and smarter
- Optional accounts so each person on the phone gets their own chats
- Chat history saved on your phone, with search, rename and delete
- Edit a question or regenerate an answer
- Custom instructions to set the assistant's tone
- Light and dark mode

Good to know: the first time you chat, Remtron5000 downloads the model you picked (about 0.3 to 1.4 GB) over the internet, so use Wi-Fi. On-device models are smaller than large cloud services. They're great for writing and explaining, but they can make mistakes, so check anything important. Requires iOS 26 or later.
